description: This file defines a SIMD vector class specialized for 512-bit vectors, primarily using AVX-512 intrinsics for integer types such as int64_t, int32_t, int16_t, int8_t, and their unsigned counterparts. It provides vectorized operations including load, store, arithmetic, comparisons, blend, arange, and shift operations optimized with hardware intrinsics. It is part of the at::vec namespace and is intended for CPU-specific vectorized computation in PyTorch's tensor library.

classes.name: Vectorizedi
classes.description: Base struct providing a wrapper around __m512i for integer vector types, with conversion and inversion functionalities.

classes.name: Vectorized<int64_t>
classes.description: Specialized class for 512-bit vectors of int64_t, providing constructors, load/store, arithmetic, comparison, and utility functions optimized with AVX-512 intrinsics.

classes.name: Vectorized<int32_t>
classes.description: Specialized class for 512-bit vectors of int32_t, with similar functionalities customized for 32-bit integers.

classes.name: Vectorized<int16_t>
classes.description: Specialized class for 512-bit vectors of int16_t, supporting vectorized operations, load/store, and comparisons.

classes.name: Vectorized<int8_t>
classes.description: Specialized class for 512-bit vectors of int8_t, supporting detailed operations including bit shifts, load/store, and comparisons.

classes.name: Vectorized<uint8_t>
classes.description: Specialized class for 512-bit vectors of uint8_t, with similar functionalities to the int8_t specialization.

classes.name: Vectorized<T>
classes.description: Template class supporting various data types, with specialization for different integer types, providing SIMD operations.

methods.description: Performs byte-level shifts emulated via shuffle and arithmetic, supporting left and right shift variants.
